description: NaPbB₅O₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.76 Å. There are five inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.37 Å) and two longer (1.39 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.34-1.41 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.51 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.53 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.35-1.40 Å. Pb is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one O atom. The Pb-O bond length is 2.24 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one B, and one Pb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two B atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms.
